Like all the products all this list, alpha arbutin *needs time* to work, and you need to stick with it. Alpha arbutin works by turning into hydroquinone once you apply it to your skin. Hydroquinone reduces the activity of the enzyme that produces melanin (or pigment) in the skin. And like all skin care, it?ôs worthless if you don?ôt protect your skin with sunscreen daily! I find the Ordinary?ôs alpha arbutin to be effective and the price is right. column10: So first of all, I see quite a bit of negative reviews for this, but before you throw in the towel and decide if this is or isn?ôt for you, then you should do some research.  I work in skin care and we test personal care products before they go on the market.  Salicylic Acid helps dead skin cells shed more easily, it helps open up clogged pores to neutralize bacteria, and then helps close them to prevent future breakouts. Benzoyl Peroxide helps skin cells turnover faster by peeling away dead layers of skin. It also has antimicrobial effects, so it it going to attack the bacteria that causes your breakouts.  So if you experience peeling, that is normal, you should reduce your use to maybe once daily and reduce the amount to a pea sized amount.  Additionally, if you tend to get really dry around your jawline, then dont use this product there.  Especially if you are not prone to breakouts on yoru jawline.Personally, I cannot use JUST salicylic acid products and expect to see a drastic change in my face.  I realized this and end up buying the acne solutions starter set by Clinique.  This set offers not only the all-over clearing treatment, but the foaming wash and the toner.  The foaming wash and toner have SA in them, and the last step is this product with BP in it.We have a special photobooth at work called the Visia, and you can take your picture and view all of the acne causing bacteria on your face under UV light (because acne-causing bacteria fluoresce under UV light - blacklight, they look orange).  Before starting the Clinique acne products the bacteria on my face was HORRENDOUS, even though I was using a SA wash.  Two weeks after using the regimen, including this product, my acne causing bacteria diminished SIGNIFICANTLY.  I was floored.  As of today I have been using the products for around 4 weeks.  The intense dryness subsided around 2 weeks.  Additionally, Clinique warns you on their website that the breakouts may get worse before they get better.I do still get the occasional hormonal breakout, and I still have some blackheads on my nose, but I attribute the general reduction in my acne to this product specifically.  Especially on my upper cheeks where you would apply highlighter.  I could never wear highlighter because it would just magnify my breakouts.  Salicylic Acid would never clear up these breakouts, and I could only see the bumps when I applied makeup.  Those breakouts are now gone.I do think you need to buy the set to have maximum benefits, and if you do not buy the set, maybe you should be using a SA wash from another brand or drugstore, along with an SA toner, prior to using this product as your last step.  Lastly, since this does have peroxide in it, it could bleach certain materials, so let it dry before laying down.  Also, wash your hands after using, or your hands could peel too.  Hope this helps!!! : )

column10: This is my first product review I believe, but as a pharmacy student who recommends products like this all the time, I feel I may be able to offer some insight.Firstly, what is this product?This product contains benzoyl peroxide 2.5%, which is a drying agent. You can get BP in many over the counter products in both 2.5% and 5% (10% is prescription, but evidence shows no benefit with this). As the lower percent, this product will be less drying than a 5% formulation and therefore is best for mild acne and more of a maintenance role.Who can benefit from this product?If you have lots of inflammation or deep blackheads, this product won?ôt help you. the best thing you can do is go see your doctor or dermatologist to get a retinoid product or antibiotic, or if very severe a product like accutane. If you have mild acne with white heads and some mild blackheads or very mild inflammation, this product is great for helping to dry out the pores and prevent future breakouts.How does this product compare to others?As said, the active ingredient is really available in many OTC products you can pick up at the pharmacy, but what I do like about this particular product is the lotion formulation. Many products come in gels, which is more drying as it evaporates, whereas the lotion lends some moisturization, and to be perfectly honest i just like the feel of this particular product on my skin and the other products in the formulation don?ôt seem to bother my skin either. as well, it comes in a large enough tube to use it all over the face and it still lasts quite a while.How best to use this product.HERE?ôS THE ONE THING YOU SHOUDL KNOW ABOUT TREATING ACNE! IT GETS WORSE BEFORE IT GETS BETTER! *(if you?ôre using a topical). it generally takes 2-4 weeks for your skin to adjust as these products are irritating- thats the point! although, having said that, depending on how naturally oily your skin is this may be very short and mild (if oily) or longer and worse (if drier), since the point of this product is to dry your skin. you should see the MAXIMUM benefit in 3-6 months, so be patient, although you should see really benefit before then.Second, if your skin is very sensitive or you find it too irritating or drying, you can adjust the way you use this product to get optimal results.
